law: The GLKit framework provides functions and classes that reduce the effort required to create new shader-based apps or to port existing apps that rely on fixed-function vertex or fragment processing provided by earlier versions of OpenGL ES or OpenGL.
This reduces the amount of code needed to create an iOS app that use OpenGL ES.
On iOS, GLKit requires an OpenGL ES 2.0 context.
In macOS, GLKit requires an OpenGL context that supports the OpenGL 3.2 Core Profile.
Use math libraries, background texture loading, pre-created shader effects, and a standard view and view controller to implement your rendering loop.
